title.en: Building Control (Value of Significant General Building Work Projects) Order 2008

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Building Control (Value of Significant General Building Work Projects) Order 2008 and shall come into operation on 18th December 2008.

heading.en: Variation of value of significant general building work project

text.en: 2. A significant general building work project is any building works the value of which is $20 million or more, instead of the value of $10 million specified in section 29H(5) of the Act.
